text:
incident-bot: INCIDNT: GPU capacity exhaustion detected in eu-west-1 cluster — autoscaler unable to add GPU nodes, queue growth on imagegen-svc. Paging oncall. https://redwood.inc/incident/1804009876 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered for oncall (priya). Priority: P1. Escalation in 5m if no ack.

alex: acked. I'm on it. seeing big backlog in the gpu-queue (imagegen). CPU pools fine.

priya: joining. quick summary?

alex: autoscaler logs: failed to attach instance profile to new nodes, then kubelet binding errors. errors: 
```
E1001 12:03:45 provider.go:213] attachRole to instance profile arn:aws:iam::123456789:instance-profile/rl-gpu failed: AccessDenied
E1001 12:04:01 kubelet_register.go:88] node registration failed: node "ip-10-0-12-45" taint gate mismatch, rejected by controller
```

sam: I see the AWS API is returning 403 for iam:PassRole for the autoscaler role when trying to spin up the nodegroup. suspect a recent IAM policy change rolled out.

priya: good catch. check whether the nodegroup uses the right instance profile name. list from infra: `rl-gpu-profile-v2` vs what autoscaler expects `rl-gpu-profile`.

alex: listing nodegroup config now.

sam: also note kubelet taints are set by bootstrap script using environment flag that changed in last deploy — nodes coming up with taint key=ml/gpu:NoSchedule but autoscaler launched using different bootstrap tag, so controller rejects binding. that's why some nodes fail after creation.

maria: flagging customer impact to CS: imagegen-svc requests queued, customers seeing increased latency and some 502s. currently ~28k items in queue, median latency 12s -> 60s. notifying top 5 tenants.

priya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause new imagegen ingestion at edge for 10m (rate limit), 2) manually increase existing GPU nodegroup desired count to unblock pending pods, 3) attach correct instance profile to nodegroup via AWS CLI, 4) restart kube-autoscaler after fix. who's doing which?

alex: I'll coordinate rate limit via API gateway rule (set 50% throttle) and update infra status.

sam: I'll attempt manual attach of instance profile and patch bootstrap tag. running commands: 
```
# attach instance profile
aws iam add-role-to-instance-profile --instance-profile-name rl-gpu-profile --role-name rl-gpu-node-role
# update nodegroup desired
aws eks update-nodegroup-config --cluster-name prod-eu --nodegroup-name gpu-pool-a --scaling-config desiredSize=10,maxSize=20,minSize=3
```

ops-bot: runbook step 3 executed by sam at 12:14 UTC. Reaction :white_check_mark:.

sam: attaching succeeded but got a warning that profile already existed under different name — I removed duplicate and re-attached.

priya: now patching bootstrap config to match expected taint key. apply daemonset config to bootstrap script via k8s secret: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system create secret generic gpu-bootstrap --from-literal=TAINT_KEY=ml/gpu
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/gpu-bootstrap -n kube-system
```

alex: rate limit applied at API gateway. Ingress down to ~30% of prior RPS. queue drain rate improved.

maria: informing customers: "We are seeing degraded GPU capacity in eu-west-1 impacting image generation; we have throttled new jobs and are provisioning nodes. ETA to recovery ~20-30m. We'll update every 10m." Sent to top tenants.

sam: successful node launches now. New nodes registering. kubelet binding still had 2 failures but majority OK.

incident-bot: Alert: autoscaler restart recommended.

priya: restarting cluster-autoscaler now.

ops-bot: cluster-autoscaler pod restarted at 12:37 UTC. logs: scaling event processed, nodes added=4.

alex: imagegen queue dropping from 28k -> 6k over 15m. error rate 502 -> baseline. good.

maria: customers reporting reduced errors, one large tenant saw 95% reduction in failures. continuing monitor.

priya: timeline and immediate postmortem items we'll capture: 
- root cause: IAM role name mismatch after policy cleanup + bootstrap taint env flag change in prior release caused binding mismatch. both needed to succeed for autoscaler nodes to be usable.
- mitigations taken: manual attach instance profile, patched bootstrap taint config, manual scale and autoscaler restart, ingress throttling to limit queue.
- customer impact: imagegen-svc latency spiked 12:04–12:42 UTC, ~38 minutes. temporary 5 tenants received errors; remediation completed at 12:42 UTC.

alex: owner for follow-up: sam (IAM + nodegroup config) and product infra for bootstrap flag rollback (ticket assigned).

maria: CS follow-up: email sent with RCA note draft.

priya: ops tasks: create automated test in staging to validate instance-profile + taint bootstrap integration. schedule retrospective 48h.

sam: created git issue infra/1256: "Node bootstrap taint env mismatch and instance-profile drift — create preflight checks". assigning to infra team.

incident-bot: Incident closed to active mitigation at 12:45 UTC; monitoring for 2 hours. Postmortem scheduled.

priya: final note: thanks everyone for quick triage. thumbs up :thumbsup:. will follow up with timeline and action owners in postmortem doc.
